shorts.hook: Sixty-six million years ago, a ten kilometer asteroid hit Mexico.
shorts.title: The Asteroid Blast Wasn't What Killed the Dinosaurs
shorts.outro: Doug was standing right under it. The full video is linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT HAPPENED TO DOUG? TAP BELOW
shorts.description: The Chicxulub impact started on a single day, but it was the soot and darkness afterward, not the blast, that finished off the dinosaurs.

shorts.hook: Two hundred fifty-two million years ago, the ocean became a hot tub.
shorts.title: The Great Dying Turned the Ocean Into a Hot Tub
shorts.outro: Doug got in anyway. All twenty-seven Doug deaths are linked below.
shorts.description: Fossil teeth show the tropical sea surface approached forty degrees Celsius after the Great Dying, the exact limit U.S. regulators set for a hot tub.

shorts.hook: The worst extinction in Earth's history started in Siberia.
shorts.title: Earth's Worst Extinction Started With Magma Burning Coal
shorts.outro: And that was only the first pulse. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: The Siberian lava wasn't the main killer; magma spreading underground cooked coal-rich rock and released huge volumes of greenhouse gas.
